human_verdict_note: LOGO_UNCROPPED_SIGN_PHOTO fix. The shipped logo.png (1017x1016, already alpha-punched around the sky) was still the FULL roadside billboard scene - sign plus mounting pole, guy wires, roadside trees and a leftover sky-cutout artifact - because stageFacebookProfileMark (lib/hydroclean-class.js) has no crop step at all, unlike stage-brand-mark.js's mark_crop mechanism: it only trim()s uniform-color margins and ships whatever EYES marked is_a_mark=true, with no way to isolate a sub-region. Applied a plain rectangular extract (left=30, top=255, width=955, height=555) on the already-shipped alpha PNG using the same sharp .extract()+trim(threshold:22)+ensureAlpha()+png() chain stage-brand-mark.js's own encodeAndWrite() uses, to drop the pole/wires/trees below the sign and the sky above it. The sign itself is still photographed at an upward angle (real trapezoidal perspective distortion on a flat, matte, well-lit printed vinyl banner - not curved or glossy), so some perspective skew on 'SOLIS TIRES AUTO SERVICE' remains; that is inherent to the source photo, not fixable by a rectangular crop, and was not attempted. Verified by rendering the output file at full size and downscaled to 56px header height - legible business name, tagline and phone number at both.
